scope: Developer attended 100 W USB-C boundary experiment only; no production admission, USB-C setter or sustained safety claim
target: RZ09-0528, 1532:02C6, BIOS 2.02, exact existing firmware and device guards
evidence: Read-only gapless swaps with the operator's 100 W charger read 0711 on USB-C only and 1111 with barrel plus USB-C, Windows AC online throughout, with no battery state

entry.power: 1111 with the 280 W barrel and the 100 W USB-C charger both connected before apply
entry.pad: Absent, two observations separated by at least 2 seconds
entry.external: Two fresh HWiNFO CPU and same-device NVML GPU observations at least 2 seconds apart; CPU <=70 C, GPU <=72 C, GPU utilization <=10 percent, independently confirmed zero offsets, no 3DMark process, attended no-workload confirmation

nativeWritePolicy: Existing exact-device, controller isolation, full-AC 1111, pad and zero-offset guards remain unchanged for every setter; no writes on 0711 or 0011

observation.bracket: Fresh Windows AC, 07/8C power, 0D/82 channels 1 and 2, 07/8C power, fresh Windows AC
observation.abortPower: A coherent battery 0011 sample with Windows AC offline is an unplanned state: it signals AbortReconnectAc, never counts as the destination, and waits within the deadline for two coherent full-AC samples before the existing cleanup
observation.windowsLimitation: Windows AC is online for both 1111 and 0711, so only 07/8C distinguishes full AC from USB-C; the setter guard reads the same register and is not an independent second source
observation.operatorSequence: Remove only the 280 W barrel after ReadyToUnplug; reconnect it on the destination signal; remove USB-C only after the validator and restoration finish
observation.transitionalSample: A well-formed bracket whose 07/8C values, paired channels or Windows AC state change within one observation is discarded without poisoning, resets the full-AC stability window, and is retried within the same deadline; any other power value, an unlisted channel mode, malformed or uncertain native reads poison
signals: Destination observed: reconnect the barrel immediately on the first coherent 0711 sample
AbortReconnectAc at most once, immediately on a tripwire, pad loss or any failed boundary
observation.limitations: No intentional USB-C dwell, external load, automatic HyperBoost re-entry, new HyperBoost apply on USB-C, power-limit claim or assertion of exact total mode-7 residence

cleanup.required: Actual external worker quiescence, fresh Windows AC and two matching complete full-AC 1111 thermal observations separated by at least 1 second; setter guards independently verify GPU zero, 1111 and isolation
cleanup.mode2: Verified no-op; no restore setter or acknowledgement claimed
cleanup.mode7: One existing guarded paired Performance restoration followed by paired readback
cleanup.other: Unknown, mixed, mode 0 or 3 on full AC, inconsistent brackets, native uncertainty or insufficient transaction reserve require pending manual recovery; no replay
cleanup.reserve: Four observation transactions plus at least eight reserved cleanup transactions
